title: x-sample
description: Model-level annotation on OpenAPI schema properties for realistic data generation. Consumed by recipes (seed data), OpenAPI docs (realistic examples), mock servers, and dev/demo fixtures. See API Handbook §10 and Vendor Extensions §6.3.

provider.description: Data generation strategy: 'faker' uses faker library paths, 'fixed' uses a literal value, 'template' uses a format string

path.description: Faker method path (e.g., 'person.firstName'). Required when provider is 'faker'.

locale.description: Locale for data generation (e.g., 'fr-CA'). Defaults to tenant locale when omitted.

format.description: Template string for the 'template' provider, or null. Supports interpolation of other faker paths.

provider.description: Matches when provider is faker to require the path field
